messages:
Erin K.: Heads-up — postmortem for the 3/12 streaming partial-response/timeouts incident. I ran a quick audit of the action items from the retro and want to lock owners + dates. Meeting notes coming, but let's capture commitments here.
Carla P.: thanks. can we split infra vs app work? infra: reconnect/backpressure and metrics. app: prompt/parsing & client retry logic.
Ben T.: I'll take app side (client retry logic + detect-partial-response hooks). ETA 2026-03-26 for a PR with tests. @Carla P. can you confirm infra ETA?
Carla P.: infra ack. I'll own reconnect/backpressure changes and a small KV-cache hazard fix. Targeting 2026-03-29 for staged rollout to canary.
Dinesh R.: adding a monitoring piece — I'll add an alert for "streaming-partial-rate" > 0.5% over 5m and a dashboard tile for average chunk latency. ETA 2026-03-24.
Frank S.: I'll update the runbook to include the new detection + mitigation steps (how to force reconnects, when to roll back model variants). ETA 2026-03-25.
Lina (SRE): quick note — we need a canary gating rule: block rollout if chunk-latency P95 increases > 20% or error-rate > 0.2%. I'll add that to the release job.
Erin K.: Good. Let's add one cross-cutting action: create a synthetic streaming test that exercises long-running sessions and partial chunk drops. Who can own?
Ben T.: I'll prototype a synthetic client harness and wire it into CI as a daily job. Will post the harness + basic failure modes as logs.
Carla P.: infra also needs an automated reconnect injection test (simulates TCP drops and slow responses). I'll put that in the infra repo under tests/chaos/stream-reconnect. ETA aligned with canary (3/29).
Dinesh R.: small detail — add a token-count metric in the streaming pipeline to detect truncated responses (tokens emitted vs expected). Will append to the telemetry PR.
Frank S.: For retrospective follow-ups, propose weekly check-ins for 4 weeks to catch regressions. Who's good to be in a 30-min sync? Erin, Carla, Ben, Dinesh, Lina + oncall rotation.
Erin K.: I'll schedule a standing 30-min sync Mon/Wed for the next 4 weeks, first meeting 2026-03-23 09:30 PT. Calendar invite coming.
incident-bot: Incident #2026-0312-STREAM closed. Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-0312-streaming.
Carla P.: quick technical note — planned infra change includes switching to continuous-batching config "cbatch_v2" and a conservative KV cache ttl bump to 2s to reduce invalidations. Will also add opt-in flag for Dedicated customers during rollout.
Ben T.: sample code I'll add to detect partial responses (on client):
```
if (last_chunk_received && total_tokens < expected_tokens) {
  emit_metric('partial_detected', 1)
  trigger_reconnect()
}
```
I'll include this snippet in the SDK PR.
Dinesh R.: timeline recap: monitoring PR 3/24, runbook 3/25, SDK + client hooks 3/26, infra rollout canary 3/29, weekly synces through 4/22. If blockers appear we'll pause canary.
Erin K.: thanks all. Action owner summary: Carla (infra rollout + reconnect tests) 3/29, Ben (client detection + SDK) 3/26, Dinesh (telemetry + alerts) 3/24, Frank (runbook) 3/25, Erin (coord + syncs). We'll reconvene after first canary on 3/29 for a quick health check. :thumbsup:
Carla P.: :thumbsup: I'll open a tracking spreadsheet and link it in the retro doc.
Ben T.: posting PR links as they land.
Frank S.: I added a note to the SLO team to consider a targeted SLO for streaming partials.
Erin K.: closing thread for now — please update the spreadsheet with PR links and statuses. We want all PRs green before wide rollout.
